description: This file defines a lightweight API client for the ExplainLike5 application. It provides functions to send prompts to a backend API endpoint for generating progressive explanations and to check if the API backend is configured, handling cases when the backend URL environment variable is not set.

methods.name: explainProgressively(prompt)
methods.description: Posts a user prompt to the backend API, expecting a structured array of explanations at different levels, throws errors if the backend URL is not configured or if the response is invalid.

methods.name: isApiEnabled()
methods.description: Checks if the backend API base URL environment variable is set, indicating whether API calls are enabled.
